c9601494.about: c9601494 (the eighth-review round) answered quit as one transaction per window: its flushers, then its final check, under a read-only lock the explorer can't model; Rust asked nothing after the flushes. Its publish cancelled only react-query reads, never the explorer's held answers. So: answerFlush = runQuitTransaction, answerCheck says nothing is outstanding, and the read hooks do nothing.
